title: Create review candidate pool and gate evidence flow
description: Connect recent-closure discovery to the required review/audit gate workflow without forcing every closed work item into mandatory review.
acceptanceCriteria: Closed items that explicitly require review or audit gates are discoverable as pending review candidates, while optional recent-closure review remains available for any scope.
Reviewer outcomes are recorded as review evidence and linked to the closed work item or gate requirement.
Doctor, gate, report, and summary surfaces distinguish pending review, passed review, and forced review bypass counts.
Workflow docs include the reviewer-agent loop for candidates since the last heartbeat checkpoint.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code before closeout.
closedReason: All acceptance criteria met with scoped commit e036b4d and passing TypeScript, focused review-candidate, and full CLI runtime verification.
